title: The Sure Thing
logline: Virginia Mosby joins a dating app for the over-fifty-fives and matches with a man Ted has known for ten years, whose entire profile is the word 'Sure'. She won't say who he is but tells Ted everything else, so he turns up to her first date in a fake mustache with a slideshow. Lily and Marshall are secretly matchmakers for both sides, and Barney's fake widowed astronaut lands a date of his own.
coldOpen: Kids, in the fall of 2011, your grandmother joined a dating app and matched with a man I'd known for ten years. It took me three days to figure out who he was. In my defense, I had never once seen him from the waist down.

couch.line: Not like that, Luke. Mostly not like that.

guests.name: Dennis
guests.role: Gloria's son, an anxious insurance actuary who turns up to spy on his mother's dating-app date in the exact same fake mustache as Ted, with a fourteen-slide presentation

scenes.summary: Ted picks Virginia up for her annual New York weekend. She's on Second Wind, an app for the over-fifty-fives, has matched with a man Ted knows, and won't say who, but she'll tell him everything else. Clues: works nights, polishes things, wonderful hands, profile is just 'Sure'. Ted imagines Barney as his stepdad. It isn't Barney: she swiped left on his widowed astronaut. Button: Lily picked out the underwear.

beats.line: Every fall, your grandmother came to New York for a Broadway show and a weekend of telling me things I can never unhear.
Teddy, I have news. I'm on Second Wind!
Is that a vitamin?
It's a dating app for singles over fifty-five. I've had nine dates. Two were the same man. He forgot.
Mom, you can't be on a dating app. They're full of weirdos. I'm on four of them.
Well, I've matched with someone wonderful. And you know him!
I know him? Who?
I'm not telling. He's a very private man.
But I'll tell you everything else.
No. Mom. That is the worst possible combination.
He works nights. He's always polishing something. And he has the most wonderful hands.
Mom.
His whole profile is one word. Sure.
That's not a profile. That's a shrug.
Your father talked for thirty years and never heard a word I said. This man says one word, and he means it.
Also, the hands.
And he says he's seen you at your absolute lowest.
Mom, that's not a clue. That's a census.
Works nights. Seen me at my lowest. Probably caused it.
Mom. Please tell me it isn't Barney.
Would that be so terrible?
Son! Daddy's home!
Teddy, say hello to your new stepfather.
Kiddo, your mother and I discussed your curfew. You don't have one. Stay out. All night. Please.
Mom!
Now get your jammies on, champ. Tonight's bedtime story is from the Playbook.
Mom. Is it Barney?
Oh, honey, no. I swiped left on Barney the very first night.
His profile says he's a sixty-one-year-old widowed astronaut.
Saturday, eight o'clock, Bellamy's. And you are not invited.
I wouldn't dream of it.
Good. I'm wearing red. Lily says it's my color. She picked out the underwear, too.
Oh, shoot. I wasn't supposed to say Lily.
That's the part you weren't supposed to say?

scenes.summary: Ted grills Lily, who set up 'Spicy Ginny' because Virginia called her the cool one. Robin's journalism concludes it's a Zamboni driver. Barney is wounded that Virginia swiped left on the Commander; Robin bets him he can't land a date by Saturday. When Ted repeats the 'Sure' clue, Marshall does a spit take, and when Carl answers Ted's order with 'Sure', Marshall flees.

beats.line: You set my mother up on a dating app? And you picked out her underwear?
She called me the cool one, Ted. I have waited eleven years for a Mosby to call me the cool one.
Come on, Ted. Your mom's out there living. Good for Ginny.
Nobody calls her Ginny.
Her username is Spicy Ginny. I'm very proud of it.
Who is he, Lily?
I don't know! His only photo is a hand. Holding a rag.
Ted. I'm a journalist. Give me the facts.
Works nights. Always polishing something. A man of few words. Has seen me at my lowest.
Works nights, polishes things, never talks, has watched you fall down a lot. Ted, it's obvious.
Who?
A Zamboni driver.
How many Zamboni drivers has Ted met?
You only need to meet one, Barney. They change you.
And you! A widowed astronaut? On an app for people over fifty-five?
Commander Barnabus Stinson. Sixty-one. Lost his wife on the moon. He doesn't like to talk about it.
Women over fifty-five have their own condos, no roommates, and zero patience for small talk. It's the last unfished lake.
And your mother swiped left on the Commander. Nobody swipes left on the Commander.
She's met you.
Twenty bucks says the Commander can't land a single date by Saturday.
Challenge accepted. The Commander is go for launch.
Guys, focus! Who works nights, has wonderful hands, and has a profile that just says Sure?
Baby?
Wrong pipe. It went down my thinking pipe.
I need a drink.
Carl, another round?
Sure.
I have to go. To a place where nobody can ask me anything.
What's with him?
He knows something. He left his nachos.

scenes.summary: Marshall cracks: Carl asked him to write his profile, and Carl is 'Sure'. Lily sees love, and free drinks for life. Marshall's four pages got cut to the one word he didn't write. Ted arrives as Fernando, in a mustache, with a fourteen-slide presentation. Barney has a date with Gloria at the same restaurant; Robin is Ted's cover date. Lily and Marshall go to save the date, and the drinks.

beats.line: By Saturday, Uncle Marshall had kept the secret for forty-one hours. A personal record.
Lily, I have to tell somebody, or I'm going to tell the mailman.
Three weeks ago, Carl asked me to help him with a dating profile. Bartender-client privilege.
Lily. Carl is Sure.
Carl? Our Carl?
Marshall. Do you know what this means?
Two lonely hearts found each other?
Free drinks. For the rest of our lives.
Lily! This is about love!
It's also about love.
Wait. You wrote Sure?
I wrote him four pages. His love of jazz. His mother's pierogi. How he hums when he cuts the limes.
He read every page. Very slowly. Then he deleted all of it and typed Sure.
It was the only word I didn't write.
Okay. Ted cannot find out before that date. If Ted finds out, Ted makes a speech.
And if Ted makes a speech at Carl, Carl cuts him off. Forever.
And everyone he sits with.
Good afternoon. I'm Fernando, a Portuguese architect. I am nobody's son.
Ted, it's a mustache.
Relax. I'm not going to ruin Mom's date. I'm just going to sit near it. And then present a few remarks.
Fourteen slides. I got it down from forty.
beats.title: What Are Your Intentions With My Mother?
lines: A presentation by Ted Mosby, architect

beats.line: Gentlemen. Lily. The Commander has a date.
Gloria. Sixty-seven. Retired judge. Tonight, eight o'clock, Bellamy's.
That's Mom's restaurant!
I know. I want the man who beat me to watch me win.
And I'm Ted's cover date. I want a front-row seat when the Commander crashes.
Nice mustache. You look like a gym teacher in witness protection.
Obrigado.
We're going too, aren't we?
We stop the slideshow. We save the drinks.
And love.
And love. Second.

scenes.summary: Virginia spots everyone instantly. Carl walks in: he's the match, and he has legs. Ted's grievances get one-word answers. Ted starts his slideshow, and Gloria's son Dennis bursts in wearing Ted's exact mustache, with Ted's exact speech, for Barney. Ted sees himself. Barney gracefully grounds the Commander. Virginia explains why Carl; Ted asks Carl one question and gets 'Sure'. Virginia undercuts with the squeaky floor above the booth. Future Ted reveals Lily knew all along.

beats.line: Hi, Teddy! Hi, Robin! Hi, Lily, hi, Marshall.
Hello, Commander.
She can't see me. I'm Fernando.
Honey, I made that face. I'd know it under a beard and a paper bag.
Nobody here knows anything. Least of all me.
Carl! You came!
Carl?
Huh. Carl has legs.
Carl? Wow. What a shock. I am totally shocked. Me. Lily.
I lost to Carl?
Astronaut.
Carl, you've seen me at my lowest. You've cut me off on three of my birthdays.
Four.
You watched me slow-dance with the jukebox!
It led.
Carl, I have prepared a few remarks—
Not the slides!
Commander Barnabus Stinson?
Gloria? You look very different from your photo.
I'm her son, Dennis. I've prepared fourteen slides on your intentions with my mother.
Party City?
Aisle nine.
Aisle nine.
Ted. That's you.
My mother has been alone eleven years. She bought a new dress for tonight. Do not waste the dress.
Dennis. Tell her the Commander has been recalled to space. She deserves a man who's actually been to the moon.
That's very decent. Also, she sent me to let you down easy. She googled the moon.
Mom. Why Carl?
Teddy, Carl has said nine words to me. And he remembers every single one of mine.
It's a lot of words.
Ten years I've told you my stories, Carl. I never asked you a single question.
Nope.
So here's one. Will you be good to her?
Sure.
Mom, you get a love story too. I'm sorry I wore a mustache to it.
Oh, honey. Now go home. Carl's taking me back to his place. He lives right above the bar.
He says the floor squeaks right over your booth.
Our booth.
Kids, your grandmother and Carl dated for two very happy years. He said about forty words. She said the rest.
Wait. Aunt Lily can't keep a secret. She really didn't know it was Carl?
Penny, Lily recognized that hand the second she saw it. She hasn't paid for a drink since 2011.
